premises.text: Detergent laundry pods use PVA that becomes microplastic pollution returning through water and food
premises.evidence_span: PVA can be found in this, the detergent laundry pod

premises.text: Upcycled agri-waste biobased polymer resins drop into existing twin-screw / plastic manufacturing lines
premises.evidence_span: our technology can apply to existing plastic manufacturing equipment, which make it very easily adoptable for our partners

premises.text: Bacterial fermentation converts diverse biomass wastes into the needed polymer, analogous to brewing
premises.evidence_span: The process is very much like brewing beer, in which we create bacteria that can intake different type of inedible biomass waste

premises.text: Joint development with Unilever and Monosol leverages their machines and infrastructure to scale commercially
premises.evidence_span: three-way partnership which we can leverage their expertise, their machines, their infrastructure, and to scale up commercially quickly

premises.text: Mechanical properties similar to PVA while using less energy/CO2 in manufacturing and eventually lower unit cost
premises.evidence_span: the mechanical property of our material has a bit similar quality as PVA

premises.text: Initial applications face easier regulation and higher-paying customers willing to pay a premium versus food-tech routes
premises.evidence_span: There's no grass FDA regulation for our initial applications

value.text: A bio-based PVA replacement that reduces microplastics in daily life
value.evidence_span: Mi Terra is the one that can help us replace PVA once for all

secondary_value.text: Environmental gains from waste upcycling and lower emissions/water use
secondary_value.evidence_span: we also care about our environment very, very much

causal_links.evidence_span: 8,000 tons of these microplastics flow into the ocean
bio-based solution to replace PVA, first of its kind

notes: NY expansion and fundraising ask excluded. Licensing roadmap treated as scale detail inside partnerships/cost, not separate premise. Application laundry-list folded into polymer replaceability.
